integrity: Proof self-contained in RESULT.md. verification.py supplies finite deterministic tests but not a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Strict local-minimum/cusp theorem is proved for every strictly positive normalized endpoint clearance; no uniqueness of either global off-center maximizer is asserted.
Not an online monitoring strategy, nor a result for noisy observations, unequal endpoints, other processes or exact minimum reconstruction.

scientific_scope: Two sequential, noiseless retrospective observations of a Brownian bridge with equal known positive endpoints; observe a nonpositive value to flag a downward-barrier excursion.
title: Adaptive two-checkpoint Brownian-bridge barrier detection breaks midpoint symmetry
